subject: Transitioning Intro Demo → Embedded Workshop — scheduling options
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara@finbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.example>
Cc: Tom Marsh <tom@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial intro — team wants deeper hands-on session

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our product and infra leads reviewed Redwood and they think an hour demo may not be enough — they'd prefer a half-day embedded workshop to run through a simple integration and validate latency/cost tradeoffs with a sample dataset. Would you be open to converting the planned demo into a 3.5 hour hands-on workshop?

Key constraints:
- Our engineering leadership is only available Week of Mar 15 (PST) and prefer afternoons.
- Two people will join remotely from London (Tom will coordinate timezones).
- Procurement will need a light SOW to confirm scope before we lock dates.

I've attached a short team roster and our security questionnaire to start.

If a workshop is possible, can you propose three 3.5-hour blocks in that week? If a full workshop isn't feasible, a 1.5 hour technical deep-dive with prework would be acceptable.

Appreciate it —
Sara

--
Sara Liu
Director, Platform Engineering
FinBridge
attachments: FinBridge_prod_team_list.xlsx, security-questionnaire-FinBridge.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.example>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.example>, Tom Marsh <tom@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial intro — team wants deeper hands-on session

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. We can definitely run an embedded workshop, and I agree it's the best way to validate integration and perf characteristics. Two quick notes up front:

1) I have a travel blackout Mar 14–16 (airport training) which limits my availability that week in the mornings; Laura can lead the workshop delivery if we need an afternoon block.
2) A 3.5-hour workshop works well if we define a tight scope and a small preconfigured sandbox. I'll put together a proposed agenda and prework.

Proposed slots (all PST) for Week of Mar 15 — pick any three options and we'll confirm:
- Tue Mar 16, 1:00–4:30 PM
- Wed Mar 17, 12:30–4:00 PM (Laura would lead first 90m while I join remotely)
- Thu Mar 18, 2:00–5:30 PM

If you prefer a shorter deep-dive first, we can do Mon Mar 15, 2:00–3:30 PM (90m) and follow with a workshop later.

Prework I'll circulate: a small sample prompt set, a tiny S3 bucket with example docs (read-only), and a short evaluation checklist so we can measure latency and costs during the session. Can you confirm which cloud region you want to test in (us-west-2 or eu-west-1)? Also loop in procurement if they'll need a stub SOW now.

I'll attach a one-page agenda and draft SOW in my next email.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
